user.title: Set up Home Ledger
user.description: Set up Home Ledger to track your household utility costs and consumption.

add_bill.title: Add a bill
add_bill.description: Enter the details of your utility bill.

data_description.utility_type: Choose the type of utility shown on the bill.
data_description.start_date: First day included in the billing period.
data_description.end_date: Last day included in the billing period.
data_description.total_cost: Total amount charged for the billing period.
data_description.consumption: Total energy, gas, or water used during the billing period.
data_description.bill_id: A custom identifier for this bill. One is generated automatically when left empty.

pv_roi.title: Configure Photovoltaic ROI
pv_roi.description: Enter the details of your PV installation to calculate the return on investment.

data_description.pv_investment: Total cost paid for the photovoltaic installation.
data_description.pv_incentives: Grants or incentives that reduce the installation cost.
data_description.pv_installation_date: Date when the photovoltaic installation started operating.
data_description.sensor_pv_production: Sensor that reports cumulative photovoltaic production.
data_description.sensor_house_consumption: Sensor that reports cumulative household consumption.
data_description.sensor_battery_energy: Optional sensor that reports energy stored in the battery.
data_description.sensor_grid_export: Optional sensor that reports energy exported to the grid.
data_description.gse_mode: Select GSE payment mechanism (Scambio sul Posto, Ritiro Dedicato, or none).
data_description.gse_export_tariff: Fixed compensation rate paid for exported energy per kWh.
data_description.sensor_gse_export_tariff: Optional sensor reporting dynamic energy export price.
